title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): The Queens of Mud! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer gives her all in the autumn Tenno Sho. She chases after the leading Daitaku Helios and thrills the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen will be the final hurrah for the two besties. Mejiro Palmer is determined to show everyone what she's found by running away from the Mejiro family.
